label: Claude usage index, Australia
question: Where is AI use most concentrated, relative to population?
answer: Australia leads global Claude usage at 6.40 times the expected baseline across 121 countries, where 1.00 is population-proportional.
methodology: Anthropic Economic Index, June 2026. Privacy-preserving aggregate statistics across 121 countries; the index is usage share divided by working-age population share. Measures one assistant, not all AI use.
